headline: Maui Boards & Commissions Reviews Vacancies and 2027 Nominations

meeting.body: Maui Boards & Commissions Reviews Vacancies and 2027 Nominations
meeting.summary: The Independent Nomination Board interviewed applicants in a closed session and set November 11th as the application deadline for 2027 mass nominations.
meeting.recap: The Independent Nomination Board met on September 23rd and was called to order at 3:45.[[0:00:35]] Staff reported resignations from the Liquor Control Adjudication Board, the Board of Water Supply and the Independent Nomination Board itself.[[0:02:26]] Board members will work recruiting shifts at the county fair.[[0:08:14]] Two members will recruit at the senior fair on November 21st at the Cameron Center.[[0:09:38]] The board voted to go into executive session (a closed-door meeting).[[0:11:13]] Applications for the 2027 mass nominations are due November 11th.[[0:13:58]] Members agreed to use the existing interview questions and grading.[[0:16:12]] The chair said the list shows 77 seats, with 64 open after taking out members eligible for reappointment.[[0:20:12]] Staff said a vacancy that had gone to the council will now go to the mayor for appointment.[[0:21:50]] Staff said the board's list for the Board of Water Supply seat is due October 19.[[0:23:25]] The October 14th meeting will be canceled if no Board of Water Supply application arrives by the 8th.[[0:26:23]] The meeting adjourned at 4:49 p.m.[[0:27:48]]
decided: The board voted to go into executive session (a closed-door meeting).
Members agreed, without a formal vote, that the October 14th meeting will be canceled if no Board of Water Supply application arrives by the 8th.
meeting.next: Staff will tell the board whether any Board of Water Supply application arrives by the 8th. Staff will update the board on whether it needs to be involved with the Central Valley community plan advisory committee. A member suggested sending applications to the working group members as they come in.

moments.q: Motion to go into executive session
"There's a total of 77 and taking out the reappoints there's 64 open seats."
